answer: Reward vesting plus withdrawal latency can make throwaway identities unprofitable. Each new agent stakes collateral; rewards accrue but unlock linearly over months, and withdrawals enter a queue. A sybil perched on the ledge of cashing out early forfeits unvested rewards and its stake, while waiting ties up capital and compute across an ocean of delay. The sable anonymity of fresh wallets buys nothing if abandoning them destroys more value than the attack earns.
